messages:
mira: AcmeBank wants a POC: streaming SDK -> function-calls for enrichment -> newline JSON output to their on‑prem parser. They require customer-managed KMS/HSM and SOC2 excerpts before pilot. Any blockers?

alex: SDK supports streaming+function_calls (node/python/go). Main infra snag: their reverse proxy strips Authorization unless we do mTLS or signed ephemeral URLs.

judy: Cost note: 15 qps, ~120 tokens in / ~600 out => reserved capacity recommended. I can run numbers if needed.

prashant: For strict JSON lines, use structured output binding and runtime schema validation. Prompt suffix: "Return exactly one JSON object per line with keys id,verdict,score,meta".

sec-bot: SOC2 report available. KMS via KMIP/AWS possible; HSM attestation requires vendor certs. Compliance bundle ticket created: INC-7890 (ETA 48h).

mira: Action list: Judy will post pricing scenarios; Alex to scope mTLS vs ephemeral URL effort; Sec to post packet; I'll schedule kickoff next Tue.

alex: mTLS path est 2-3 eng days + coordination; ephemeral signed URL est ~1 day.

judy: Pricing posted by EOD.

mira: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
